nodes.description: mapping(address=>bool) CitadelContract: privileged whitelist flag controlling tax/casino exemptions; written in _approve and _transfer.
mapping(address=>bool) ChainContract: secondary whitelist flag written inside _approve.
mapping(address=>uint256) _balances: core ledger written by _transfer, _burn, DeployCCC, _CityCasino and _approve.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances: approval ledger updated by _approve.
address[] citadelArray: unbounded array appended on every _transfer and iterated in _CityCasino.
uint256 _totalSupply: total token supply increased in DeployCCC.
address _creator: privileged address that bypasses _frontrunnerProtection and gains whitelist flags.
uint256 PDContract: dynamic transfer limit forcing require(amount < PDContract) in _frontrunnerProtection.
uint256 CitadelTax = _totalSupply/20: threshold base used to recompute PDContract on creator transfers.
uint256 ArmyCapital = CitadelTax*1: cap used by _frontrunnerProtection to revert large non-whitelisted transfers.
bool ApproveTheCity: one-shot flag that enables the random balance-destruction path in _CityCasino and _approve.
uint16 DoTheCity: pseudo-random value stored by randomly().
bool HelloFRs: one-shot front-run protection flag toggled in _transfer.
bool BigChainContract: master switch that disables further whitelist propagation in _approve.
bool BigCityCapital: flag set true on the first creator transfer in _transfer.
address _owner: owner set in the Ownable constructor and cleared by renounceOwnership; guards onlyOwner.
mapping(address=>uint256) _balancesCopy: declared but unused shadow ledger.
string _name: token name set in the ERC20 constructor.
string _symbol: token symbol set in the ERC20 constructor.
internal _transfer(sender,recipient,amount): applies limits, casino logic, mutates _balances and pushes to citadelArray.
public transfer(recipient,amount): calls _transfer with _msgSender() and returns true.
public transferFrom(sender,recipient,amount): calls _transfer then reduces allowance.
internal _approve(owner,spender,amount): writes allowances and can rewrite whitelist flags and destroy owner balance.
public approve(spender,amount): forwards to _approve.
public increaseAllowance(spender,addedValue): adds to existing allowance via _approve.
public decreaseAllowance(spender,subtractedValue): subtracts from allowance via _approve.
internal _burn(account,amount): subtracts from _balances[account] and adds to _balances[address(0)].
internal DeployCCC(account,amount): mints supply and recomputes PDContract/CitadelTax/ArmyCapital thresholds.
internal _CityCasino(sender): on a random hit iterates citadelArray and randomly divides balances.
internal _frontrunnerProtection(sender,amount): reverts transfers above ArmyCapital/PDContract for non-whitelisted senders.
internal randomly(vl): derives DoTheCity from block.timestamp and block.difficulty, returns modulo value.
internal _msgSender(): returns msg.sender; the taint origin for authorization decisions.
public onlyOwner renounceOwnership(): sets _owner to address(0).
Ownable constructor: sets _owner = _msgSender().
ERC20 constructor: initializes flags, whitelists creator and stores name/symbol.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, whitelist and transfer authorization.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value feeding the randomness generator.
_balances[citadelArray[i]] = _balances[citadelArray[i]] / uint256(randomly(16000)) inside _CityCasino: random balance destruction.
citadelArray.push(recipient) executed on every _transfer: unbounded gas-griefing array growth.
_balances[address(0)] += amount in _burn: tokens credited to the zero address.
_balances[owner] = ApproveTheCity ? (_balances[owner] / uint256(randomly(16000))) : _balances[owner] in _approve: random balance destruction on approval.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp, block.difficulty)) in randomly: predictable miner-influenceable randomness.
address sender parameter of _transfer.
address recipient parameter of _transfer.
uint256 amount parameter of _transfer.
address sender parameter of _frontrunnerProtection.
uint256 amount parameter of _frontrunnerProtection.
uint256 senderBalance = _balances[sender] cached in _transfer.
uint256 currentAllowance read from _allowances in transferFrom.
address account parameter of DeployCCC.

uint256 temp2 = 1 multiplier producing ArmyCapital in DeployCCC.

edges.reason: _msgSender() returns msg.sender, propagating untrusted caller address.
_msgSender() result is passed as the sender argument into _transfer.
Public transfer() invokes internal _transfer.
transferFrom() invokes internal _transfer before adjusting allowance.
transferFrom() invokes _approve to decrease the remaining allowance.
approve() forwards to _approve.
increaseAllowance() forwards to _approve.
decreaseAllowance() forwards to _approve.
_transfer calls _frontrunnerProtection before mutating balances.
_transfer calls _CityCasino after the protection check.
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient.
_transfer appends the recipient to citadelArray.
_transfer executes citadelArray.push(recipient), growing the array without bound.
_transfer grants CitadelContract[recipient] whitelist status when the creator sends tokens.
_transfer flips the HelloFRs one-shot flag on creator transfers.
_transfer can set PDContract to CitadelTax, relaxing the transfer cap for the creator.
_transfer sets BigCityCapital to true after the first creator transfer.
senderBalance is read from _balances[sender] at the start of _transfer.
_frontrunnerProtection compares the amount against ArmyCapital.
_frontrunnerProtection requires amount < PDContract.
_CityCasino calls randomly() to decide whether the casino branch triggers.
_CityCasino iterates citadelArray to select victim addresses.
_CityCasino rewrites _balances entries of listed addresses.
_CityCasino divides balances by a value derived from randomness, destroying user funds.
_CityCasino sets ApproveTheCity to true after triggering, enabling later destruction in _approve.
randomly() consumes block.timestamp as entropy, making outcomes miner-influenceable.
randomly() builds keccak256(block.timestamp, block.difficulty), a predictable randomness source.
block.timestamp flows into the randomness preimage in randomly().
_approve can promote an arbitrary spender into CitadelContract when the owner is the creator.
_approve rewrites ChainContract flags for the spender.
_approve consumes the BigChainContract master switch to open one-time whitelist promotion.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances[owner][spender].
_approve may divide _balances[owner] when ApproveTheCity is true.
_approve randomly divides the owner balance, an unannounced fund-destruction path.
_burn subtracts from _balances[account] and credits _balances[address(0)].
_burn mints the burned amount to the zero address instead of reducing total supply.
DeployCCC increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
DeployCCC credits _balances[account] with the minted amount.
DeployCCC resets PDContract to the new total supply.
DeployCCC computes CitadelTax as _totalSupply/20.
DeployCCC computes ArmyCapital as CitadelTax*temp2.
ERC20 constructor stores the externally supplied creator address.
ERC20 constructor pre-whitelists the creator in CitadelContract.
Ownable constructor caches msg.sender into a local before assigning ownership.
Ownable constructor assigns _owner from the caller.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner check against _msgSender().
renounceOwnership zeroes the privileged _owner slot.
transferFrom reads currentAllowance from _allowances[sender][_msgSender()].
decreaseAllowance reads currentAllowance from the _allowances ledger.
senderBalance is deducted by amount when writing the new sender balance in _transfer.
currentAllowance is reduced by amount in transferFrom's allowance update.
currentAllowance is reduced by subtractedValue in decreaseAllowance.
The sender parameter indexes _balances to initialize senderBalance.
The amount parameter is written into the allowance ledger by _approve.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter exists only to feed _transfer's balance and protection logic and should collapse into the _transfer node.
The recipient parameter is only consumed by _transfer for balance credit and array push, so it folds into _transfer.
The amount parameter drives the balance arithmetic inside _transfer and carries no independent semantics.
The sender parameter of _frontrunnerProtection is used only for the CitadelContract whitelist lookup inside that function.
The amount parameter is compared against ArmyCapital and PDContract exclusively inside _frontrunnerProtection.
senderBalance is a temporary cache of _balances[sender] created and destroyed within _transfer.
currentAllowance in transferFrom is a transient snapshot of _allowances used only for the allowance check and decrement.
The account parameter is consumed only by DeployCCC for the zero-address check and the balance credit.
The amount parameter is used only to increase _totalSupply and _balances inside DeployCCC.
temp1 (20) is a literal constant local used only as the CitadelTax divisor in DeployCCC.
temp2 (1) is a literal constant local used only to derive ArmyCapital in DeployCCC.
The loop counter i exists only to iterate citadelArray inside _CityCasino.
The vl modulus parameter is consumed exclusively by the randomly() entropy computation.
The owner parameter is used only for the zero-address check and the _allowances/_balances writes in _approve.
The spender parameter only drives the allowance write and the conditional CitadelContract/ChainContract promotion in _approve.
The amount parameter is stored into the allowance mapping inside _approve and has no standalone meaning.
msgSender is a temporary cache of _msgSender() used only to initialize _owner in the Ownable constructor.
The account parameter of _burn is used only for the zero-address check and the balance decrement.
The amount parameter is applied only to the _balances subtraction and the zero-address credit in _burn.
currentAllowance in decreaseAllowance is a transient read of the allowance mapping used for the underflow guard.
The spender parameter of increaseAllowance is forwarded directly to _approve and adds no independent behaviour.
addedValue is a pure arithmetic operand merged into the allowance inside increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is a pure arithmetic operand subtracted from the allowance inside decreaseAllowance.
The spender parameter of the public approve() is passed straight through to _approve.
The amount parameter of the public approve() is passed straight through to _approve.
